run_chat_command: run the vLLM chat CLI command to generate chat completions via the running API server
run_complete_command: run the vLLM complete CLI command to generate text completions based on a given prompt
build_chat_interactive_cli: build an interactive chat CLI that streams responses from an OpenAI-compatible API server
build_completion_interactive_cli: build an interactive completion CLI that streams text completions from an OpenAI-compatible API server
test_chat_command: test the ChatCommand CLI subcommand with a system prompt and quick message
